title: Local Metric3 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=local:metric3
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day local metric3 (3) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on local metric3 (3) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It rates what time of day your local metric3 (3) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
